init_distributed_process_group: initialize a PyTorch distributed process group with a given GPU ID, rank, world size, and backend
all_reduce_sum_tensor: sum a tensor across all distributed processes using all_reduce and return the aggregated result
all_reduce_average_tensor: average a tensor across all distributed processes by summing and dividing by world size
reduce_dict_values: reduce a dictionary of tensor values across all processes with optional averaging enabled
all_gather_pickle_data: gather arbitrary picklable data from all distributed ranks into a single list
